# Einleitung

The keyword, word-count, correspondence, and equal-contribution labels are in German, as are the appendix headings here and in the TOC. Each reference should match the value after the colon:

- @sec-methoden: Anhang A
- @sec-anhang: Anhang B
- @nte-d: Box 1

Notes are labelled with the extension's own term; other callouts keep Quarto's German labels.

::: {#nte-d .callout-note}
## Titel
Text.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Ohne Titel.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
Ein Hinweis.
:::

```{=typst}
#show: appendix.with()
```

# Methoden {#sec-methoden}

Text.

# Anhang {#sec-anhang}

A heading titled just "Anhang" renders as "Anhang B".
